info.title: OpsNinja API
info.description: OpsNinja is a multi-tenant SaaS support and incident-management platform. This document describes the versioned, publicly supported tenant-facing REST surface. Internal endpoints (health, auth, admin, Jira integration) are excluded from this document.

tags.name: portal-tickets

tags.name: agent-tickets

tags.name: sla-policies
tags.description: SLA policy and calendar management, timer state.

post.summary: Add a public comment to a portal ticket
post.description: Visibility is always forced to `public`. Supplying a `visibility` field returns 400. Replies to closed tickets return 422 TICKET_CLOSED unless the tenant policy permits re-open.

get.summary: Get a pre-signed download URL for a portal attachment

200.description: Pre-signed download URL valid for 5 minutes.

post.summary: Obtain a pre-signed S3 POST URL for portal attachment upload
post.description: Returns a pre-signed S3 POST URL and form fields. The client POSTs the file directly to S3 (multipart/form-data), then calls the confirm endpoint. The OpsNinja API never receives the file body.

201.description: Pre-signed upload URL and attachment record.

post.summary: Mark a portal attachment upload as complete

200.description: Attachment confirmed and ready to be linked to a ticket.

patch.description: Optimistic concurrency: include the current `version` from a prior GET in the `If-Match` header or `version` body field. Returns 409 on stale version.

example.issue: String must contain at least 1 character(s)

TraceId.description: Correlation ID echoed from X-Trace-ID request header.

nextCursor.description: Continuation token. Null when no further pages exist.

CommentVisibility.description: Comment visibility (public = visible to customer portal).

AddPortalCommentRequest.description: visibility field MUST NOT be present.

CursorParam.name: cursor
CursorParam.description: Opaque base64url-encoded continuation token. Omit to start from the first page.

LimitParam.name: limit
LimitParam.description: Number of items to return per page. Maximum 100.

BadRequest.description: Bad Request — validation failed or malformed input.

Unauthorized.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid bearer token.

NotFound.description: Not Found — resource does not exist or is out of scope.

TooManyRequests.description: Too Many Requests — rate limit exceeded.

Retry-After.description: Number of seconds to wait before retrying.

StaffBearer.description: OIDC JWT issued by the tenant identity provider (Okta / Entra ID). Staff and agent principals.

PortalBearer.description: Portal-scoped JWT bound to a single customer organisation.

MachineToken.name: X-Api-Key
MachineToken.description: Long-lived tenant-issued API key for machine-to-machine integrations.
